component.name: Lanterna
component.summary: Show photos, slides, videos and films on your TV with Chromecast
Mostra foto, presentazioni, video e film sulla TV con Chromecast

description.p: Lanterna sends photos, videos and films from this computer to a TV through the Chromecast the TV has inside, and can show the whole screen or a single window there too. The TV plays a file itself whenever it can, so the picture keeps its full quality; only what the TV cannot play is converted on the fly.

Lanterna manda foto, video e film da questo computer alla TV attraverso il Chromecast che la TV ha dentro, e può mostrarci anche tutto lo schermo o una sola finestra. Quando può, è la TV a riprodurre il file, così l'immagine conserva tutta la qualità; solo ciò che la TV non sa riprodurre viene convertito al volo.

ul.li: Finds the TVs on the network by itself and remembers the one used last
Trova da sola le TV sulla rete e ricorda l'ultima usata
Photos one at a time, chosen, dropped or a whole folder
Foto una alla volta, scelte, trascinate o un'intera cartella
Films with their sound converted only when the TV cannot play it
Film con l'audio convertito solo quando la TV non sa riprodurlo
Pause, seek, the TV's volume, previous and next, from the window or the keyboard
Pausa, posizione, volume della TV, precedente e successiva, dalla finestra o dalla tastiera
The screen or a window on the TV, with the sound, while this computer keeps quiet
Lo schermo o una finestra sulla TV, con l'audio, mentre questo computer resta in silenzio

description.p: Only the TV you are showing something on can fetch it, and only while you show it: a TV used before is let go. The connection to the TV takes TLS 1.2 or newer only. On Windows the licence's text and the list of the components inside come with the program.
A fixed port for the TV, off by default: with it, a TV on another network behind a firewall needs a single port let through. The icon's flame without the dark line round its edge.

The first public version: the TVs found on the network, photos, videos and films shown on the TV at full quality (only what the TV cannot play is converted), pause, seek, volume, previous and next, the screen or a window with its sound, and the app's own icon.
First version: a folder counted, with the preferences, the translations, the installer for Windows and the Flatpak for Linux every app of this author has.
